Shop My Account Program Ads & Sponsorships Program Advertisement Get your business noticed & support Shakespeare on the Sound!
• Our 30th Anniversary season, this year producing Much Ado About Nothing!

• Total of 17 performances: June 10th - 28th in Rowayton’s Pinkney Park • Playbills to be distributed to thousands of audience members • Professional Broadway style program read and kept by patrons as a show souvenir Contact Russell Coleman for more information: marketing@ShakespeareOnTheSound.org ​ Ad Size/Rate: FOR ADVERTISERS ONLY, SPONSORS ADS INCLUDED _____ $1,000 / Full Page Color/4.25” x 7.25” _____ $500 / Full Page B&W/4.25” x 7.25” _____ $450 / Half Page Color/4.25” x 3.5” _____ $250 / Half Page B&W/ 4.25” x 3.5” _____ $150 / Quarter Page (Vertical) B&W / 2” x 3.5” _____ $150 / Quarter Page (Horizontal) B&W / 4.25” x 1.75” Inside and back covers reserved for SPONSORS ONLY ​ Sponsorship "“I do love nothing in the world so well as you— is not that strange?” - Benedick, Much Ado About Nothing ​ 30th Season Sponsorship Levels and Opportunities ​ Title Sponsor and Associate Producer of Summer Season $20,000 10 reserved seats with swag bags for opening night or one performance of choice 8 additional High Back VIP reserved seats to use as requested throughout production run Top billing on title page of program Prominent ad features on banner, advertising, website, and all social media Title Sponsor/Underwriter of Children’s Program $10,000 Details TBD but title billing in all verbiage re the Children’s Program Multiple performances at area libraries and event spaces throughout the Spring Workshop with Associate Artistic Director.

Underwriter of Community Night Performance (Tues) $10,000 Opportunity to bring SOS to a broader community by supporting the “Pay as you can” pricing plan Underwriter credit featured prominently in playbill, advertising, website and social media 10 reserved High Back VIP seats with swag bags Introduce Tuesday night performances during the Curtain Speech and welcome patrons Performance Sponsor – Weekend (Fri-Sat-Sun) $7,500 6 reserved High Back VIP seats with swag bags Introduce the performance during the Curtain Speech and welcome patrons Sponsorship acknowledged with prominent sticker placed on all playbills handed out : “Tonight’s performance brought to you by _____” Performance Sponsor – Weeknight (Wed-Thurs) $5,000 4 reserved High Back VIP seats with swag bags Introduce the performance during the Curtain Speech and welcome patrons Sponsorship acknowledged with prominent sticker placed on all playbills handed out : “Tonight’s performance brought to you by _____” Underwriter of Apprentice Company $2,500 More than one opportunity available Featured in advertising, website, social media Pizza party with apprentices Introduce the Understudy Run of the Apprentice Company matinee performance Shakespeare on the Sound i s a proud member of the Shakespeare Theatre Association Where Shakespeare Lives Now!

Contact PO Box 15, Norwalk, CT, 06853 contactus@shakespeareonthesound.org Box Office for June (203) 957-1006 Follow Us © 2026 Shakespeare on the Sound Questions should be directed to Stephanie Eiss, Director of Education: stephanie@shakespeareonthesound.org .
